unitTitle: Prepositions of Place - Was/Were - Had - Could
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 41-BET. Unit 9 — 1-9-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 8-mashq (13 bo'shliq), 9-mashq (22 bo'shliq), 10-mashq (10 ta xatoni tuzatish), 11-mashq (10 ta variant tanlash) — jami 55 ta javob.

⚠ 9-MAShQNING 3-BANDI — ENG ChALKAShTIRUVChI JOY:
  Ro'yxat: could, can, can't, couldn't, were (BESh so'z, BESh bo'shliq).
  To'g'ri javob:
     A: CAN your sister cook?          (hozir)
     B: No, she CAN'T.
     B: COULD you cook when you WERE nine?   (o'tmish)
     A: No, I COULDN'T.
  ⚠ Bir qarashda birinchi savolni 'Could' deb boshlagingiz keladi, lekin unda ro'yxatdagi so'zlar yetmay qoladi.
  ⚠ TEKShIRISh USULI: beshta so'zning HAR BIRI ROPPA-ROSA BIR MARTA ishlatiladi. Agar biror so'z ortib qolsa yoki ikki marta kerak bo'lsa — javob noto'g'ri.

⚠ 10-MAShQNING KALITI — VAQT SO'ZI FE'LGA ZID:
  Har bir gapda vaqt ko'rsatkichi bor va u fe'l zamoniga MOS EMAS. Xatoni topish uchun vaqt so'ziga qarang:
     'when he was two'    → can  → COULD
     'when he IS five'    → o'tmish gapida → WAS
     'at the moment'      → was  → IS
     'now'                → could → CAN
     'fifty years ago'    → didn't had → didn't HAVE
     'last night'         → are  → WERE
     'then'               → isn't → WASN'T
  ⚠ 3 va 6-bandda xato boshqacha: 'did/didn't' dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda bo'ladi ('Did you HAVE', 'didn't HAVE').

⚠ 11-MAShQ 3-BAND: 'My mother is A Maths teacher' — 'M' harfi undosh TOVUSH bilan aytiladi ('em' emas, 'maths'), shuning uchun A.
⚠ 11-MAShQ 9-BAND: 'A BOWL of soup' — sho'rva kosada beriladi. 'a cup of tea/coffee', 'a bowl of soup', 'a plate of rice' — barqaror birikmalar.
⚠ 11-MAShQ 10-BAND: 'CAN I help you, sir?' — xizmat ko'rsatishda standart ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in am/'m (not), is, are, aren't, was, were, wasn't, weren't, can, could, had or didn't have.
exercises.instructionUz: am/'m (not), is, are, aren't, was, were, wasn't, weren't, can, could, had yoki didn't have ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI SHAKL — TO'RT GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  HOZIRGI 'to be':   am / 'm not, is, are, aren't
  O'TGAN 'to be':    was, were, wasn't, weren't
  QOBILIYAT:         can (hozir), could (o'tgan)
  MULK (o'tgan):     had, didn't have

TANLASH TARTIBI:

  1) Keyin FE'L keladimi?
        HA  → can / could
        YO'Q → 'to be' yoki 'had'

  2) Zamon qaysi?
        now, today → hozirgi
        ... ago, when I was ..., then → o'tgan

  3) Ega birlikmi, ko'plikmi?

DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Are you ...?    → No, I'm not.
  Was there ...?  → No, there wasn't.
  Could you ...?  → No, I couldn't.

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ you ten years old?
items.whyUz:
Yosh so'ralmoqda, vaqt belgisi yo'q → HOZIRGI zamon.
'you' → ARE.
So'roq gapda boshda.

'Are you ...?' savoliga → 'No, I'M NOT.'
'I am not' ning qisqa shakli.
DIQQAT: 'I amn't' shakli YO'Q.

'I' → AM ('I'm twelve' ham to'g'ri).
Yosh aytishda 'to be' ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 2  A: ............ you swim when you were five?
items.hintUz: Keyin FE'L ('swim'); 'when you were five' — o'tgan
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L → 'can/could'.
'when you were five' → O'TGAN → COULD.

items.textEn: 2  B: No, but I ............ swim now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon → CAN.
Ma'nosi: o'shanda suza olmasdim, hozir olaman.

items.textEn: 3  A: ............ there an airport here twenty years ago?
items.whyUz:
'twenty years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'an airport' BIRLIK → WAS.
'Was there ...?' — 'Was' boshda.
Savol 'Was there ...?' → javob 'No, there WASN'T.'

items.textEn: 3  ... but there ............ one now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'one' bu yerda 'an airport' o'rniga turibdi — BIRLIK → IS.
'There is one now' = hozir bittasi bor.

items.textEn: 4  There ............ green fields here when I was little, ...
items.whyUz:
'when I was little' → O'TGAN zamon.
'green fields' KO'PLIK → WERE.

items.textEn: 4  ... but there ............ many now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'but' → INKOR (ilgari bor edi, hozir yo'q).
Ko'plik → AREN'T.

items.textEn: 4  There ............ any hotels or shops then.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'then' = o'shanda → O'TGAN.
'hotels or shops' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.

items.textEn: 5  We ............ a supermarket then, ...
items.whyUz:
'then' → O'TGAN zamon.
Supermarket bor edi — mulk/mavjudlik → HAD.
DIQQAT: 'did' yo'q → HAD (have EMAS).

items.textEn: 5  ... but we ............ any department stores.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' va 'but' → INKOR.
O'tgan zamon + mulk inkori → DIDN'T HAVE.
DIQQAT: 'didn't had' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the lists.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ KICHIK MASHQ — HAR BIRIDA O'Z RO'YXATI.
Har bir ro'yxatdagi so'zlar AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

RO'YXATLAR:
  1  could, have got, couldn't, can
  2  is, hasn't got, was, had
  3  could, can, can't, couldn't, were
  4  had, have got, haven't got
  5  aren't, didn't have, has got, had
  6  haven't got, aren't, are
  7  wasn't, was, were
  8  haven't got, is, isn't

Har bir mashq HOZIRGI ↔ O'TGAN qarama-qarshiligi
ustiga qurilgan: ilgari qanday edi, hozir qanday.

USUL: avval har bir bo'shliq uchun zamonni aniqlang,
so'ng ro'yxatdan mos shaklni tanlang.
Ro'yxatdagi so'z soni bo'shliq soniga TENG —
bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi.

items.textEn: 1  (could, have got, couldn't, can)  When I was six, I ............ drive a car, ...
items.hintUz: Olti yoshli bola mashina hayday oladimi?
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: 6 yoshli bola mashina hayday OLMAYDI → INKOR.
'When I was six' → O'TGAN → COULDN'T.

items.textEn: 1  ... but I ............ ride a bicycle.
items.whyUz:
'but' → TASDIQ.
O'tgan zamon → COULD.
6 yoshda velosiped haydash — tabiiy.

'Now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
Keyin OT ('a car') keladi, fe'l emas → HAVE GOT.

items.textEn: 1  ... and I ............ drive it very well.
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L → 'can/could'.
'Now' → HOZIRGI → CAN.
Bir gapda ikkisi: 'have got' (mulk) + 'can' (qobiliyat).

items.textEn: 2  (is, hasn't got, was, had)  When Cathy ............ four, ...
items.whyUz:
'Cathy' BIRLIK → WAS.
'When Cathy was four' = Keti to'rt yoshda bo'lganida.

items.textEn: 2  ... she ............ many dolls to play with.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'to play with' = o'ynash uchun ('with' oxirda).

items.textEn: 2  Now she ............ sixteen ...
items.whyUz:
'Now' → HOZIRGI.
'she' BIRLIK → IS.
Yosh aytishda 'to be'.

items.textEn: 2  ... and she ............ any dolls.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
Hozirgi zamon + 'she' → HASN'T GOT ('haven't got' EMAS).
Ma'nosi: 16 yoshda qo'g'irchoq o'ynamaydi.

items.textEn: 3  (could, can, can't, couldn't, were)  A: ............ your sister cook?
items.hintUz: Keyin FE'L; o'tgan zamon belgisi bormi?
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L ('cook') → 'can/could'.
O'tgan zamon belgisi YO'Q → HOZIRGI → CAN.
'Can ...?' savoliga → 'No, she CAN'T.'

items.textEn: 3  B: ............ you cook when you ............ nine?  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz: 'when you were nine' → O'TGAN → COULD.

items.textEn: 3  B: ............ you cook when you ............ nine?  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz: 'you' → DOIM WERE.

'Could ...?' savoliga → 'No, I COULDN'T.'
2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda hozirgi (can't) edi.

items.textEn: 4  (had, have got, haven't got)  I ............ a computer now, ...
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'I' → HAVE GOT.

items.textEn: 4  ... but I ............ a typewriter.
items.whyUz:
'but' → INKOR.
Hozirgi + 'I' → HAVEN'T GOT.

items.textEn: 4  I ............ a typewriter when I was fourteen.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
Ma'nosi: 14 yoshda mashinka bor edi, hozir yo'q.
'a typewriter' = yozuv mashinkasi.

items.textEn: 5  (aren't, didn't have, has got, had)  My town ............ a theatre now, ...
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'My town' BIRLIK (3-shaxs) → HAS GOT.

items.textEn: 5  ... but it ............ a theatre twenty years ago.
items.whyUz:
'but' → INKOR.
'twenty years ago' → O'TGAN → DIDN'T HAVE.

items.textEn: 5  It ............ many parks.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon davom etmoqda (20 yil oldin haqida).
Tasdiq → HAD.

items.textEn: 5  There ............ any parks now.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'now' → HOZIRGI.
'parks' KO'PLIK → AREN'T.
Ma'nosi: ilgari bog' ko'p edi, hozir yo'q.

items.textEn: 6  (haven't got, aren't, are)  A: ............ those your cats?
items.whyUz:
'those' KO'PLIK ko'rsatish olmoshi → ARE.
'Are those your cats?' = Anavilar sizning mushuklaringizmi?
'Are ...?' savoliga ko'plik javob → 'No, they AREN'T.'

'ANY' → INKOR.
'I' → HAVEN'T GOT.

items.textEn: 7  (wasn't, was, were)  A: ............ you at home last night?
items.whyUz:
'last night' → O'TGAN.
'you' → WERE.

'I' → WASN'T.
DIQQAT: savolda WERE, javobda WASN'T — ega o'zgardi.

items.textEn: 7  B: I ............ at a party.
items.whyUz:
'I' → WAS.
'at a party' = ziyofatda.

items.textEn: 8  (haven't got, is, isn't)  A: ............ he your brother?
items.whyUz:
'he' BIRLIK → IS.
Hozirgi zamon (qarindoshlik doimiy).
'Is ...?' savoliga → 'No, he ISN'T.'

items.textEn: 8  B: I ............ any brothers.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'I' → HAVEN'T GOT.
Ma'nosi: umuman akam-ukam yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  He CAN talk when he was two.  →  COULD
  ('can' o'chirilib, chetiga 'could' yozilgan)

Har bir gapda BITTA xato bor — DOIM ZAMON xatosi
yoki fe'l shakli xatosi.

UCH XIL XATO BU MASHQDA:

  1) ZAMON MOS EMAS
     Gap ichida o'tgan zamon belgisi bor, lekin fe'l
     hozirgi zamonda (yoki teskarisi).
        He CAN talk when he WAS two.   → could
        Bobby could play basketball NOW. → can

  2) 'DID/DIDN'T' DAN KEYIN NOTO'G'RI SHAKL
        Did you HAD a TV?     → have
        They didn't HAD CDs.  → have

  3) EGA BILAN MOS EMAS
        I ARE good friends.   → was

USUL: avval gapdagi VAQT so'zini toping
(when he was five, now, at the moment, fifty years ago,
last night, then), so'ng fe'l unga mos keladimi — tekshiring.

items.textEn: 1  He can talk when he was two.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'when he WAS two' → o'tgan zamon.
Demak 'can' emas, COULD bo'lishi kerak.
To'g'ri gap: He COULD talk when he was two.

items.textEn: 2  Steve couldn't drive a car when he is five.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
Gapning boshi O'TGAN zamonda ('couldn't') →
'is' ham o'tgan bo'lishi kerak → WAS.
To'g'ri gap: Steve couldn't drive a car when he WAS five.

items.textEn: 3  Did you had a TV then?  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'Did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan →
keyingi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda → HAVE.
To'g'ri gap: Did you HAVE a TV then?

items.textEn: 4  My dad was at work at the moment.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' = ayni damda → HOZIRGI zamon.
'was' emas, IS bo'lishi kerak.
To'g'ri gap: My dad IS at work at the moment.

items.textEn: 5  Bobby could play basketball now.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'could' emas, CAN.
To'g'ri gap: Bobby CAN play basketball now.

items.textEn: 6  They didn't had CDs fifty years ago.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'didn't' + ASOSIY shakl → HAVE.
3-band bilan bir xil qoida.
To'g'ri gap: They didn't HAVE CDs fifty years ago.

items.textEn: 7  I are good friends with Joe when I was ten.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
IKKI xato birga: 'I' hech qachon 'are' olmaydi,
va 'when I was ten' o'tgan zamon → WAS.
To'g'ri gap: I WAS good friends with Joe when I was ten.

items.textEn: 8  I have a lot of books when I was little.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'when I was little' → O'TGAN zamon.
'have' emas, HAD.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'did' yo'q → HAD (have EMAS).
To'g'ri gap: I HAD a lot of books when I was little.

items.textEn: 9  They are at the party last night.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'last night' → O'TGAN zamon.
'They' KO'PLIK → WERE (was EMAS).
To'g'ri gap: They WERE at the party last night.

items.textEn: 10  There isn't a post office here then.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'then' = o'shanda → O'TGAN zamon.
'a post office' BIRLIK → WASN'T.
To'g'ri gap: There WASN'T a post office here then.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq 1-9 unitlarning HAMMASINI tekshiradi:
joy predloglari, was/were, artikllar, some/any,
egalik olmoshlari, harakat predloglari, much/many,
qisqa javoblar, idish nomlari, muloyim savol.

items.textEn: 1  A: I can't find my shoe!  B: It's ............ the sofa.
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: yo'qolgan tufli odatda divan OSTIDA bo'ladi → UNDER.
'between' ikkita narsa kerak (bitta divan bor).
'above' = tepasida, havoda — mantiqsiz.

items.textEn: 2  When I ............ five, I could read.
items.whyUz:
'I' → WAS ('were' EMAS).
'could read' o'tgan zamonni tasdiqlaydi → 'am' ham noto'g'ri.

items.textEn: 3  My mother is ............ Maths teacher.
items.hintUz: Kasb oldidan artikl kerakmi? 'Maths' qaysi tovush bilan boshlanadi?
items.whyUz:
Kasb aytishda artikl SHART: 'She is A teacher'.
'Maths' /mæθs/ — 'm' UNDOSH tovush → A ('an' EMAS).
'a Maths teacher' = matematika o'qituvchisi.

items.textEn: 4  There aren't ............ chairs in the kitchen.
items.whyUz:
'aren't' — INKOR gap → ANY.
'some' tasdiq gapda ishlatiladi.
'a' + ko'plik ot ('chairs') mumkin emas.

items.textEn: 5  A: Is this John's coat?  B: Yes, it's ............ .
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'JOHN'S coat' — Jon ERKAK → HIS.
'mine' = meniki;  'yours' = seniki.
'his' — egalik olmoshi, ot kerak emas.

items.textEn: 6  We always go ............ bed before 12 o'clock.
items.whyUz:
'go TO bed' = yotmoq — o'zgarmas ibora.
DIQQAT: 'bed' oldidan artikl YO'Q ('go to THE bed' XATO).
Shunga o'xshash: go to school, go to work.

items.textEn: 7  ............ sugar do you want in your coffee?
items.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → HOW MUCH.
'How many' sanaladigan otlar bilan (How many cups?).
'How long' — davomiylik yoki uzunlik uchun.

items.textEn: 8  A: Are they watching television?  B: No, they ............ . They're having dinner.
items.whyUz:
Savol 'ARE they ...?' bilan boshlangan →
qisqa javobda ham 'are' → 'No, they AREN'T.'
Qisqa javobda SAVOLDAGI yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi.

items.textEn: 9  I'm not very hungry. I just want a ............ of soup for lunch.
items.whyUz:
'a BOWL of soup' = bir kosa sho'rva — o'zgarmas birikma.
'a cup of' — choy/kofe uchun.
'a plate of' — quyuq taom uchun (plov, makaron).

items.textEn: 10  ............ I help you, sir?
items.hintUz: Do'kon yoki mehmonxonada xodim nima deydi?
items.whyUz:
'CAN I help you?' = Yordam bera olamanmi? —
do'kon, mehmonxona, idorada xodimning standart iborasi.
'Do I help you?' — mantiqsiz.
'Would I help you?' — noto'g'ri qolip
('WOULD YOU like ...?' bo'lardi).

groups.ruleUz: Keyin OT keladimi yoki FE'L — hal qiluvchi savol
groups.explanationUz: Bu savol 'have got' bilan 'can' ni ajratadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I had a typewriter when I was fourteen, but I have got a computer now.
patterns.exampleUz: O'n to'rt yoshimda yozuv mashinkam bor edi, lekin hozir kompyuterim bor.

patterns.formula: Ega + HAVE/HAS GOT + ot   ↔   Ega + CAN + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Now I have got a car and I can drive it very well.
patterns.exampleUz: Hozir mashinam bor va uni juda yaxshi haydayman.
patterns.explanationUz: Keyin OT bo'lsa 'have got';  FE'L bo'lsa 'can'.

patterns.exampleEn: There aren't any parks now. I haven't got any cats.
My mother is a Maths teacher.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kasb aytishda artikl SHART.
Undosh tovush → a;  unli tovush → an.
Do'kon, mehmonxona, idorada xodimning standart iborasi.

patterns.formula: a BOWL of soup  /  a CUP of tea  /  a GLASS of water
patterns.exampleEn: I just want a bowl of soup for lunch.
patterns.explanationUz: Sanalmaydigan taom va ichimliklar idish nomi bilan sanaladi.
